items.headline: Major cloud provider restores service after six-hour regional outage
items.summary: A large cloud provider said a faulty configuration change caused a six-hour outage in one region, disrupting storage and compute for thousands of customers. Services are fully restored, and the company promised a detailed post-incident report within a week.
items.why_this_story: Covered by many sources and affects a large share of cloud users.

items.headline: Lawmakers pass framework for testing high-risk AI systems
items.summary: A legislature approved a framework requiring developers of high-risk AI systems to run safety tests and publish results before release. The rules take effect in eighteen months, and smaller companies get extra time to comply.
items.why_this_story: A new rule that will shape how AI products are built and released.

items.headline: Central bank holds interest rates steady for third meeting
items.summary: The central bank kept its benchmark rate unchanged, citing slowing inflation but a still-tight job market. Officials signaled a possible cut early next year if price growth keeps easing.
items.why_this_story: Interest rates affect loans, savings, and tech hiring budgets.

items.headline: Open-source code assistant model tops community leaderboard
items.summary: A small open-weights model built for code completion climbed to the top of a popular community leaderboard, beating several larger models. Developers credit its training data cleanup and say it runs on a single consumer GPU.
items.why_this_story: Coverage of this story jumped sharply overnight.

items.headline: City marathon sets participation record
items.summary: A city marathon drew a record number of finishers this weekend, with organizers crediting new beginner pacing groups. The winning time was close to the course record despite strong winds.
items.why_this_story: One of the most-shared general stories in the last 24 hours.

items.headline: Popular dataframe library ships major release with faster joins
items.summary: A widely used dataframe library released a new major version with joins that run up to three times faster and lower memory use. The release drops support for some older APIs, so maintainers published a migration guide.
items.why_this_story: Teams that use this library may need to update existing code.

items.headline: Researchers disclose flaw in common container image tool
items.summary: Security researchers disclosed a flaw in a common container image build tool that could let a malicious image read files on the build host. A patched version is available, and maintainers recommend upgrading CI runners first.
items.why_this_story: Anyone running container builds in CI should patch soon.

items.headline: Study links short daily walks to better sleep
items.summary: A study of several thousand adults found that people who walked at least twenty minutes a day fell asleep faster and reported better sleep quality. Researchers say the effect held regardless of the time of day.
items.why_this_story: A simple, low-cost habit with a measurable effect on sleep.
